Only methods declared in sugar-diff/src, or inherited from a parent declared there, are listed. A type that extends a class outside that tree, such as \RuntimeException, does not show the methods of that class.

SugarCraft\Diff

Diff final class

A computed unified diff between a "before" and an "after" side.

MethodSummary
static compute(string|array $before, string|array $after, ?DiffOptions $options = null): selfDiff two sides. A string input is counted the way git diff counts lines — a trailing newline terminates the last line rather than adding an empty one; a list<string> input is read as pre-split lines, each one exactly one line: an element carrying an interior "\n" (what file($path) returns without FILE_IGNORE_NEW_LINES) is refused fail-fast, because emitting it would produce a marker-less row that breaks the patch for every reader. List sides are therefore always read as terminated, and DiffOptions::withNoNewlineAnnotation() can only annotate an unterminated end on STRING sides.
isEmpty(): boolWhether the two sides are equal under the active comparison options.
lines(): arrayThe full line-mode op sequence, in order, with 1-based old/new line numbers per side — the derived half of the model. compute() retains only the hunk bodies and the packed op bytes; this walk materializes one Line per input row on first call and returns the memoized list thereafter. Consumers that render changed regions should read self::$hunks; calling this on a huge diff costs what the old eager model always cost.
addedLines(): intTotal added rows — counted on the packed op bytes, no materialization.
removedLines(): intTotal removed rows — counted on the packed op bytes, no materialization.
unified(string $oldPath, ?string $newPath = null): stringThe full diff -u text for this change: two header rows plus every hunk. Returns '' when the sides are equal, exactly like the ported unifiedDiff() — a caller can trust "no output" to mean "no change".
unifiedWithLabels(string $oldLabel, string $newLabel): stringThe patch text with caller-supplied header labels (no a//b/ prefix, no /dev/null substitution) — every label still passes the row-forgery guard. See UnifiedFormat::writeWithLabels().
hunkText(): stringEvery hunk's @@ header and body without the --- +++ file headers.

DiffOptions final class

Immutable knob-set for Diff::compute() and the unified writer.

MethodSummary
static new(): selfThe faithful-port defaults: 3 context lines, exact comparison, plain headers.
withContextLines(int $lines): selfUnchanged-context window per hunk; negative requests clamp to 0.
withMaxLcsCells(int $cells): selfLCS-table cell budget; negative requests clamp to 0 (always fall back).
withIgnoreWhitespace(bool $ignore = true): selfTreat lines equal when their whitespace-stripped forms match (emitted text keeps original bytes). "Whitespace" is every \s match — Unicode-aware on valid UTF-8 (NBSP and U+2028 fold away alongside CR), byte-wise ASCII whitespace only on the malformed-UTF-8 failover — so this is deliberately stronger than git's --strip-trailing-cr: a CRLF file compares equal to its LF form line by line, and interior runs of tabs/spaces vanish from the comparison (not from the output).
withIgnoreCase(bool $ignore = true): selfCompare lines case-insensitively (emitted text keeps the old-side bytes).
withNoNewlineAnnotation(bool $on = true): selfAnnotate rows that sit at an unterminated end-of-file with \ No newline at end of file, and — with it on — treat a differing final-line terminator as a change: the boundary line renders GNU's -c / +c pair with the annotation under the unterminated side, patch-faithful (sugar-diff-022). Only meaningful for STRING sides of Diff::compute() — a list<string> side is always read as terminated (elements may not carry newlines at all), so no row on it can ever sit at an unterminated end and this annotation stays inert.
withDevNullOnEmptySide(bool $on = true): selfLabel an empty side's header row /dev/null (git's new/deleted-file shape).
withOldOffset(int $lines): selfShift every old-side number (hunk headers and row line numbers alike) by this many lines; negative requests clamp to 0. Lets a consumer present a hunk as living further down a file — the relocation the candy-code diff window used to do by regexing the private @@ grammar — without the grammar ever leaving the library (sugar-diff-001).
withNewOffset(int $lines): selfShift every new-side number by this many lines; negative requests clamp to 0.

Hunk final class

One @@ -oldStart,oldLen +newStart,newLen @@ hunk: the display anchor pair plus the context/change rows it covers.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly int $oldStart, public readonly int $oldLines, public readonly int $newStart, public readonly int $newLines, public readonly array $lines)
header(): stringThe @@ -a[,b] +c[,d] @@ header line, without its trailing newline.
lines(): array
removedCount(): intHow many - rows this hunk carries (deletions only — context excluded). O(1): counted at construction.
addedCount(): intHow many + rows this hunk carries (additions only — context excluded). O(1): counted at construction.

Line final class

One row of a computed diff: its kind, the verbatim line text, and the old-file / new-file line numbers it lands on — either of which is null when that side has no line there (a del row has no new line, an ins row no old line).

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly LineKind $kind, public readonly string $text, public readonly ?int $oldNumber, public readonly ?int $newNumber)
marker(): stringThe unified-format column-0 marker for this row.
toUnifiedRow(): stringThe row exactly as diff -u writes it: marker, text, newline.

LineKind enum

What a single diff row does: carry context, remove an old line, add a new one.

Cases: Equal · Delete · Insert

PHP also provides cases(), from() and tryFrom().

MethodSummary
marker(): stringThe unified-format column-0 marker for this kind (' ', '-', '+').

SugarCraft\Diff\Reader

ScanRowKind enum

What kind of row a scanned line of a unified diff is — the discriminator that lets a viewer tell real content from decoration instead of re-sniffing the marker column, the fragile path a bare (null, null) tuple cannot express: an @@ row, out-of-hunk prose, and a \ No newline annotation can all share that one shape.

Cases: Context · Insert · Delete · HunkHeader · FileHeader · NoNewlineAnnotation · OutsideHunk

PHP also provides cases().

MethodSummary
isContentRow(): boolAny row a pairing renderer may place in a run (vs decoration/corruption).

ScannedLine final class

One scanned row of an existing unified diff: the old-file and new-file line numbers it lands on — either null when that side has no line there (+ rows have no old line, - rows no new line, headers neither) — whether the row was read as a file header, and what KIND of row the walk decided it was.

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly ?int $old, public readonly ?int $new, public readonly bool $fileHeader, public readonly ScanRowKind $kind = ScanRowKind::OutsideHunk)

UnifiedScan final class

Walks an already-rendered unified diff and tells a viewer which line of which file each row points at — the region/hunk model any renderer (or patch tool) can use to number rows without owning the counting rules. The candy-code gutter mirrors these rules and now delegates its scan half here (ScannedLine): numbering, file-header verdicts and hunk recognition ride self::lines() and self::isHunkHeader(); only the fixed-width gutter formatting stays app-side (D1a fold — landed on both sides).

MethodSummary
static lines(string|array $diff): array
static fileHeaders(string|array $diff): arrayWhich rows are file headers rather than diff content, under exactly the rule isFileHeader() documents — and exactly the rule self::lines() walks. One pass over the rows, no ScannedLine allocated (sugar-diff-025 leg B: this used to re-invocate the whole scan and map it).
static rowsOf(string $text): arrayCount lines the way the writer's parser does — a trailing newline terminates, it does not add an empty final row — so a raw diff string scans row-for-row with what was written. Public so renderers pairing rows against self::lines() output split text exactly once.
static isHunkHeader(string $row): boolWhether a row is a @@ ... @@ hunk header — recognition, not numbering.

SugarCraft\Diff\Writer

SideBySideFormat final class

Lays a diff out as side-by-side rows: each SideBySideRow pairs one old-side line with one new-side line, so a removed/added run reads as two parallel columns instead of an interleaved -/+ stream.

MethodSummary
static rows(Diff $diff): arraySide-by-side rows for a computed diff: every hunk body walked with the pairing rule, hunks emitted in order. Empty for an unchanged pair.
static fromUnified(string|array $patch): arraySide-by-side rows for an already-rendered unified patch — raw text or its rows — numbered through UnifiedScan::lines() and classified by its row kind, so a viewer that only ever holds patch text (git output, a stored diff) gets the same layout as one that holds a computed Diff. The scan and the raw rows stay row-for-row (both split via UnifiedScan::rowsOf() for strings) — that zip is the invariant this method relies on; never re-split the text by other means here.

SideBySideRow final class

One visual row of a side-by-side (split) diff: the old-side line and the new-side line standing at the same screen row — either null when that half has no line there (a paired replacement carries both, a leftover removal only left, a lone addition only right).

MethodSummary
__construct(public readonly ?Line $left, public readonly ?Line $right)
isPaired(): boolWhether both halves carry a line (a context row or a paired edit).

UnifiedFormat final class

Renders a computed Diff in the GNU diff -u / git diff --no-color text shape: two --- / +++ header rows (no timestamp — the git form, since the engine diffs content, not files on disk) followed by @@ -a,b +c,d @@ hunks with ' '/-/+ marker columns.

MethodSummary
static write(Diff $diff, string $oldPath, ?string $newPath = null): stringThe full patch text — --- +++ headers plus every hunk. '' when the sides are equal, so callers can treat empty output as "no change".
static writeWithLabels(Diff $diff, string $oldLabel, string $newLabel): stringThe same full patch text with CALLER-SUPPLIED header labels — the additive entry for consumers (candy-code's diff window) that hand the header their own file-ish names and must not go back to string building for it: the labels ship through quotePath() verbatim, so a hostile name can never forge a +++ row (sugar-diff-003). No a/ or b/ prefix is forced and no /dev/null substitution happens — what you pass is what is quoted and emitted. Equal sides emit '' like self::write().
static hunksOnly(Diff $diff): stringEvery hunk's header and body, without the file-header rows.
